text:
nina.marketing: Quick URL orchestration question before Wed promo — we're shipping a short-form launch post + webinar recording. Need decisions on canonical, redirect pruning, anchor text plan, and sitemap priority. Can @hugo_seo + @marta_ops weigh in? doc: https://tiny.redwood/url-orch

hugo_seo: Happy to. My quick rec: declare canonical to /learn/benchmark-narrative-compact (that will be the long-form resource). Keep /product/benchmarks as a supporting page that uses a self-contained summary and links to canonical with descriptive anchor text.

marta_ops: Noted. Any redirects to consolidate? I can schedule cutover with eng.

nina.marketing: There are a few legacy campaign paths: /benchmarks-jan, /benchmarks-lp-2024, and /benchmarks-old. Some are 302s. We should prune or 301 -> canonical. Also need to decide sitemap.xml priority for the learn page (0.8?) and whether to include lastmod.

hugo_seo: Yes — 301 all campaign variants to the canonical. For sitemap: set priority 0.8, include lastmod = publish date, and add <changefreq>weekly</changefreq> for first month. Also: anchor copy guidelines: use descriptive anchors like "LLM inference benchmarks" or "benchmark walkthrough"; avoid generic "read more" or "click here".

paul_release: I'll need a redirect ticket. Suggested workflow: create RED-4098 with list of old paths, planned 301 target, cutover window Tue 10am PT, rollback in 30m. Include smoke tests: crawl for redirect chains + verify rel=canonical.

marta_ops: I'll open RED-4098 now. Ops checklist: 1) run `redirect-scan --path /benchmarks*`; 2) create planned 301s; 3) add automated smoke via `screaming-frog --crawl https://redwood.com/learn/benchmark-narrative-compact`; 4) validate JSON-LD at validator.schema.org.

ops-bot: redirect-scan: /benchmarks-jan -> 302 -> /promo/jan-bench, /benchmarks-old -> 410, /benchmarks-lp-2024 -> 302 -> /legacy/bench. Recommendation: 301 all active campaign paths -> /learn/benchmark-narrative-compact. Run: `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchmarks-jan /learn/benchmark-narrative-compact --note "promo consolidation"`

hugo_seo: One more SEO nuance: A/B test two meta-title variants for first 48 hours to measure CTR. Variant A: "LLM Inference Benchmarks — Latency & Cost | Redwood". Variant B: "Benchmarking LLM Inference: Throughput, Latency, Cost | Redwood". Use GA event to capture promo CTR and organic impressions.

nina.marketing: Good call. We'll QA meta titles in the staging table and roll with A/B via our analytics snip. Also — internal linking velocity: prioritize links from high-traffic pages (docs, pricing, case studies) in the first 72 hours to pass link equity. Hugo, can you drop a prioritized anchor list?

hugo_seo: Will do. Prioritized anchor list (short): "LLM inference benchmarks" -> /learn/benchmark-narrative-compact, "inference pricing examples" -> /pricing, "batching and latency tradeoffs" -> /docs/batching, "startup benchmark case study" -> /case-studies/startups. Keep anchor text consistent across pages.

marta_ops: RED-4098 created, assigned to eng-release. Cutover Tue 10am PT, rollback at 10:30am PT. I'll post to #release-war-room and attach the QA checklist.

paul_release: Ticket RED-4098 confirmed. Will run smoke: crawling + JSON-LD validation + canonical tag check + mobile UA header test. If any redirect chain > 2 hops, rollback.

nina.marketing: Excellent. Action items: hugo finalize anchor list + meta A/B, marta run redirects + QA, paul run cutover. Ping here when done. Promo copy will be locked after redirect consolidation. :sparkles:
